hotspots.name: Red Tent
hotspots.description: A cozy red tent for sleeping
hotspots.interactionText: Zzz... You take a nice nap in the red tent. Sweet dreams!

uses.text: You snuggle into the red tent with your hot cocoa. This is the most perfect moment ever. ☕
You put the Moon Rock under your pillow in the red tent. Sweet space dreams! 🌑
You swap in the sleeping bag from the blue tent. DOUBLE the coziness! 💤

hotspots.name: Blue Tent
hotspots.description: A blue tent with a comfy sleeping bag
hotspots.interactionText: You snuggle into the blue tent. So peaceful!

uses.text: You swap your pillow into the blue tent. The PERFECT sleeping arrangement! 🛏️
You sip hot cocoa in the cozy blue tent. Outside it's cold. In here it's perfect! ☕

hotspots.name: Rain House
hotspots.interactionText: You go inside the house. It's warm and dry in here!

uses.text: You bring your flashlight inside the house. Now you can read under the covers! 🔦
You tuck Teddy Bear in by the fireplace. The house feels even cozier now! 🧸

hotspots.name: Flying Car
hotspots.interactionText: VROOOOM! The flying car zooms through the sky! Wheee!

uses.text: You toss the Frisbee and the Flying Car zooms after it like a dog! VROOOOM FETCH! 🥏
The Flying Car bats the beach ball with its wing! BOING BOING BOING! 🏐
You snap on your helmet before the joyride. Safety first, even at 300mph! ⛑️
You open the umbrella and FLOAT up like Mary Poppins! The Flying Car gives you a lift! ☂️
You use the baseball glove to catch the Flying Car as it zooms by! Caught it! 🧤
You scrub the Flying Car with the sponge until it shines like a mirror! ✨

hotspots.name: Stairs
hotspots.description: Stairs going up to the treehouse
hotspots.interactionText: You climb up the stairs. What a view from up here!

uses.text: You try the key in a mysterious knothole on the treehouse stairs. CLICK — a secret door opens! 🗝️
You open the umbrella and leap from the treehouse stairs — you float gently to the ground! ☂️
You bang the bat on every step of the treehouse stairs. BOOM BOOM BOOM! A stair-drum concert! 🥁

hotspots.name: Purple Stairs
hotspots.interactionText: You zigzag up and down the purple stairs. Wheee!

uses.text: You sit on the pillow and WHOOSH — you slide all the way down the purple stairs! WHEEE! 🛏️
You sail the Frisbee up the zigzag stairs. It curves perfectly and lands right at the top! 🥏
You tie the rope to the railing and zip-line all the way down! WHEEEEE! 🪢
You put on goggles and charge up the purple stairs at TOP SPEED. Maximum aerodynamics! 🥽
You clang the frying pan on every step of the purple stairs. DONG DONG DONG! Camp concert! 🍳

hotspots.name: Stars
hotspots.interactionText: You look up at the beautiful stars. They twinkle and shine!

uses.text: You hold up your lantern to join the stars. It glows proudly among them! 🏮
You look at the stars through binoculars. There's a WHOLE GALAXY up there! 🔭
You try to toast your marshmallow on a shooting star. TOO HOT! But perfectly golden! 🍡
You leave a cookie for the stars as an offering. A shooting star zooms by to say THANK YOU! 🍪
You hold up your mug and make a toast to the stars. CHEERS! ☕
You hold the bat up toward the stars like a magic wand. You're a baseball wizard! ⭐
You peer through your goggles at the stars. They look ENORMOUS! A star winks at you! 🥽
You toss the beach ball up toward the stars. It bounces off one and comes back! 🏐

hotspots.name: Big Tree
hotspots.interactionText: You look up at the big tree. A leaf flutters down!

uses.text: You climb up and check the map. You can see the WHOLE camp from here! Best navigator ever! 🗺️
You aim the telescope at the treetop. There's a bird's nest up there! Hello little birds! 🐦
You use the walking stick to tap a branch. A leaf bonks you right on the nose! 🍃
You lather up the soap and blow bubbles that float all the way up to the treetop! 🫧
You TP the big tree! It waves its toilet-paper streamers in the breeze. ART. 🧻
You tie the rope to the biggest branch and SWING like Tarzan! AHHHHH-AHHH! 🪢
You place the apple at the base of the tree. A squirrel DASHES down and grabs it! 🍎🐿️
You eat your sandwich under the big tree. A squirrel watches you enviously. 🥪🐿️
You shine the flashlight up into the dark tree. A wide-eyed owl blinks back at you! 🦉
You hang the sleeping bag between two branches for the BEST outdoor nap spot ever! 💤

hotspots.name: Camp Stove
hotspots.interactionText: Sizzle sizzle! You cook a delicious camp meal!

uses.text: You heat up your mug of cocoa on the camp stove. Warm, chocolatey, PERFECT! ☕
You try to cook the acorn on the stove. A squirrel appears OUT OF NOWHERE and steals it! 🐿️
You fan the camp stove flames with the leaf. They ROAR up! The marshmallows toast instantly! 🍃🔥
You try to cook the Moon Rock on the stove. It glows and hums! Very cosmic! 🌑
You cook the apple on the camp stove. Camp applesauce! It smells AMAZING! 🍎
You accidentally drop the baseball on the hot stove. SIZZLE! It bounces straight UP! ⚾

hotspots.name: Sink
hotspots.interactionText: Splish splash! You wash your hands nice and clean!

uses.text: You put on the raincoat and splash in the sink as hard as you can. DRY AS A BONE! 🧥
You brush your teeth at the sink with extra enthusiasm. Your smile SPARKLES! 🪥✨

hotspots.name: Ball Cart
hotspots.description: Get a ball to play with!
hotspots.interactionText: You grab a colorful ball from the cart. Let's play!

uses.text: You toss the baseball into the cart. PERFECT SHOT! All the other balls cheer! ⚾🎉
You hang the baseball glove on the cart. Now it's the fanciest ball cart at camp! 🧤

hotspots.name: Baseball Game
hotspots.interactionText: SWING! You hit the ball far across the camp! Home run!

uses.text: You kick the soccer ball at the baseball field! NEW SPORT INVENTED: SOCCERBALL! ⚽
You use the frying pan as a baseball bat. CLAAANG! That ball is going to SPACE! 🍳
You eat your sandwich between innings. The best camping snack! Go team! 🥪
You unroll toilet paper as a scoreboard banner. HOME TEAM: 1. AWAY TEAM: 🧻
You use the Frisbee as home plate! It's the most stylish diamond in camp! 🥏

hotspots.name: Bathroom
hotspots.interactionText: You use the bathroom. Don't forget to wash your hands!

uses.text: You bring the soap to the bathroom. Now the handwashing station is COMPLETE! Very sanitary! 🧼
You use the sponge to wipe down the bathroom. Spick and span! Camp chores: ✅ 🧽

hotspots.name: Flying Lunchbox
hotspots.interactionText: The lunchbox opens up! Inside there are sandwiches, fruit, and cookies!

uses.text: You use the Flying Car key on the Lunchbox. It opens with a magical VROOOOM sound! 🗝️
You offer the acorn to the Flying Lunchbox. It opens up and trades you a cookie! 🌰🍪
You use the giant leaf as a plate for your flying lunch. So eco-friendly! 🍃
The Flying Lunchbox squirts juice everywhere, but your raincoat keeps you perfectly dry! 🧥
You check the star chart for the Flying Lunchbox's flight path. It's ASTRONOMICAL! 🌌
You use the baseball glove to catch a flying sandwich from the Lunchbox! PERFECT CATCH! 🧤

hotspots.name: Moon
hotspots.interactionText: The moon glows softly. What a magical night at camp!

uses.text: You zoom in on the Moon with your telescope. You can see the footprints! 🔭🌙
You introduce Teddy Bear to the Moon. They become best friends FOREVER! 🧸🌙
You hold up the map and mark the Moon's exact location. OFFICIAL MOON SIGHTING! 🗺️
You leave a cookie for the Moon. It slowly reaches down a moonbeam... and takes it! 🌙🍪
You offer the marshmallow to the Moon. It s-t-r-e-t-c-h-e-s down and takes a bite! 🍡🌙
You poke the Moon gently with the walking stick. The Moon WIGGLES! 🌙
You mark the Moon's exact spot on your star chart. SCIENCE! 🌌🌙
You try to brush the Moon. It's a bit big... but it looks shinier now! 🌙🪥
You peer at the Moon through binoculars. You can see the craters clearly! 🌙🔭
Your lantern has a long chat with the Moon about who glows brighter. The Moon wins... barely. 🏮🌙
